items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: I forget his brother's name. Joe Rene. Joe Rene, yeah, was playing drums.

ctx.x: And his brother was on the bass. Walter Deco was on the piano. Now this fellow called Gaier, I don't know his name. All I know of him, remember he got, he met with a misfortune in the place. Yeah. Now the drummer, who did he, he had his brother on drums. I forget his brother's name. Joe Rene. Joe Rene, yeah, was playing drums. How was he?
A pretty good drummer? I never got to hear him play.
